verdict.rationale: AvaTax exposes AI-powered tax code recommendations (ranked suggestions with confidence levels) and an MCP server enabling conversational queries over transactions and nexus data, which is a step toward answering 'why did this invoice tax this way' type questions. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated tax-question chatbot that cites specific rule-base entries or statutes when explaining taxability determinations — the AI features shown are narrower (product tax-code classification, transaction lookup) rather than a general Q&A system with citations. Missing for 10: a documented conversational tax-Q&A assistant that answers 'is this taxable in state X' with rule citations, evidence of citation-backed explanations for specific tax calculations, and independent confirmation of accuracy/usefulness of any such AI feature.
